headline: No scored news; endings drift as earlier stories fade
body: A quiet day with no scored events. The endings drifted by hundredths of a point as earlier announcements slowly faded from the calculation: most endings eased a touch while 1984 and Reversion ticked up. Horizon Balance edged down to +2.18.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.05 and Enslaved God -0.05.
